Jumped Well Went Forward Settled Down 3 Wide 6th 4 Lengths 800m lost spot 10th 10 Lengths home turn Four Wide last no run on Straight # wide/never in it
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat rail 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, found little dropped out # weak run home

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Niggled early & raced behind Mid Field Two Wide (5L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Five Wide @ 400m. Chasing Seven Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Worked home steadily Seven Wide in last 200m. # Even effort.
Jumped Ok settled back 6l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat rail 8l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well without threatening # hit line well
Got the job done as fave two starts ago before looming and peaking on the run last time. Best to go both ways.
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn then Hooked Out to 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide , lost a little in Straight # Wide from turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped with another runner passing the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out pressed forward, sat 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, angled clear Straightening Up 1 length off, still 1 length off approaching 200m, same approaching 100m, kept finding the line final 50m, got up in the shadows # had run/did enough
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping and shortly after bumped a runner on the hindquarter.
